entry.title: The Limit of a Function as a Value

content.snl: def-hyp(list-partial(Type.judge(@F, Analysis.PFun), Type.judge(@x, Real)), Analysis.funLimVal(F, @y, x), Analysis.funLimVal(F, @y, x))
content.markdown:
The value counterpart of `BasicAnalysis.def.funLimit`, and likewise partial. The same value form is reused for the one-sided limits and the limits at infinity, each with its own notation.

This is the layer on which the derivative is defined: the derivative value at a point is the value of the limit of the difference quotient, so differentiability becomes "that value is present" rather than a fresh quantifier block.
